title: [GMCP 203.018.M] Mastery: Client connection runtime, caching, retries, and concurrency
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-018-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: The client runtime pools only security-equivalent connections, honors ttlMs and cacheScope, invalidates on notifications, applies deadline and cancellation budgets, retries only safe operations with jitter and circuit breaking, and enforces per-server plus global concurrency and memory bounds. Reconnect, half-open, duplicate-response, slowloris, crash-loop and thundering-herd tests prove deterministic recovery without duplicate side effects. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
